rv.q: This is the most thrilling dance-driven musical since Twyla Tharp's wordless 'Movin' Out' in 2002.
Beneath the considerable pizazz, Wheeldon conveys with grace and style the heartfelt romance and emotional colors that keep us enchanted until the last beautiful note has been sung.

By marshaling dance as few others have on Broadway in recent memory, Wheeldon has provided us a jolting reminder of the incomparable, incalculable power of dance to speak of our deepest longings and agonies when words and even lyrics cannot.

cn.t: Critics hail Christopher Wheeldon's "An American in Paris" as a sublime, dance-driven triumph that transcends its film origins with exuberant choreography, emotional depth, and sweeping innovation—the most thrilling musical of its kind in years.
